node.statement: Polar coherence and scalar naturality: for every exact-unit algebra and every two polar data (delta_j, S_j, u_j, h_j), j = 1, 2, for which Pi_{delta_j}: calU x B^{calH}_{delta_j}(J) -> S_j, (U, H) |-> U bold-dot H, is bijective with inverse (u_j, h_j), one has (u_1, h_1) = (u_2, h_2) on S_1 intersect S_2; moreover, for c in U(1) and X, cX in S_j, u_j(cX) = c*u_j(X) and h_j(cX) = h_j(X).
